title: Pad Nifty 1.1 & Habitat II
native_title: パッド・ニフティ１．１＆ハビタット２
overview:
This disc brings together two ways to go online with the Sega Saturn: Pad Nifty 1.1 for the NIFTY-Serve network and the Habitat II virtual world, plus an internet browser.

Pad Nifty, developed by Fujitsu, gives NIFTY-Serve a graphical interface operated with the control pad. In Habitat II you take on an avatar and visit Elysium, an island town, chatting with other members who are online at the same time. The browser lets you visit web pages through your own internet provider.

- Pad Nifty 1.1, Habitat II and an internet browser on one disc
- Requires the Sega Saturn Modem and a phone line
- Sega Saturn Keyboard required for Habitat II
- Shuttle Mouse and memory backup support
